comment: Identifiers and vocabulary for agent work tracking. Skills read this file instead of hardcoding them. Opaque node IDs (project fields, status options) are resolved at run time with gh, never stored here.

statusOptions.In Progress: Being implemented or awaiting merge. Blockers and review findings are comments plus the `blocked` label, not a separate status.
statusOptions.Done: Issue closed as completed: for repository changes, the PR is merged to main and main CI is green; for pure investigation, the result is recorded on the issue.

issueTypes.Bug: Observed behaviour differs from expected. Must be reproducible.
issueTypes.Feature: New user-visible capability. Parent issues of epics are Features labelled `epic`.
issueTypes.Task: Engineering work without new user-visible behaviour: refactor, CI, tooling, docs, spike.

labels.duplicate: This issue or pull request already exists
labels.wontfix: This will not be worked on
labels.area:ci: CI, container toolchain, ui-agent, agent instructions
labels.area:core: Pohunek protocol client, state model, reconciliation, layout store
labels.area:platform: Android specifics: background service, notifications, packaging
labels.blocked: Cannot progress; comment names the blocker
labels.epic: Parent issue delivered by native sub-issues
labels.found-during-work: Filed by an agent while working on another issue
labels.needs-decision: Waiting for an owner decision; options and recommendation in the issue
labels.area:terminal: Embedded terminal view, libghostty-vt, attach stream

milestones: One milestone per delivery phase from docs/architecture.md; every non-epic issue belongs to exactly one milestone.
authorization: See .agents/instructions/workflow.md#standing-authorization. Agents never ask whether to file an issue; they deduplicate and file.

pullRequests.shape: One issue, one branch, one squash-merged PR. Split large issues into sub-issues instead of stacking PRs.
pullRequests.closingKeyword: Closes #N in the PR body, only when the PR meets the issue's full DoD; otherwise Refs #N.
